goal: Makes wallet encryption and passphrase-change operations atomic so a failed disk write can't leave memory and disk state diverged
Protects users from unlockable-but-locked wallets or lost/duplicated key records after a local storage failure during these operations

Verified by testing: jeanpablojp built and tested the change (jeanpablojp)

why: P2 because it fixes real fund-safety and consistency hazards in encryption and passphrase-change paths
Affects any user hitting a local storage failure during these rare but security-sensitive operations
Not release-blocking since the description notes these failures cannot be triggered remotely, and complexity vs benefit was debated
